metadata.title: $L^{p}$-parabolicity of Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: We describe the $L^p$-parabolicity of a Riemannian manifold in terms of a unified theory of nonlinear $L^p$-capacities, for the whole range $1\leq p\leq \infty$. For example, the \(L^{1}\)-parabolicity is equivalent to the usual notion of parabolicity/recurrence, while \(L^{2}\)-parabolicity is equivalent to biparabolicity. For any $1\leq p\leq \infty,$ the $L^p$-parabolicity turns out to be equivalent to the $L^q$-Liouville property for positive superharmonic functions, where $p$ and $q$ are Hölder conjugate exponents. We also provide a new capacitary characterization of the $L^1$-Liouville property. Finally we obtain an almost optimal volume growth condition for the $L^p$-parabolicity for $1<p\leq 2$ as well as a sharp volume condition for all $1<p<\infty$ for manifolds of non-negative Ricci curvature and for model manifolds.
metadata.comment: This is a revised and expanded version of a paper originally posted on A. Grigor'yan's webpage and also available on ResearchGate. The main new result is the proof, in the Riemannian setting, that the (2,1)-Laplacian capacity is twice the usual variational capacity, thereby extending a theorem of Brezis, Marcus, and Ponce. This answers a question raised in the first version of the paper

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 容量与抛物性的统一刻画
analysis.workSummary: 在全部 1≤p≤∞ 范围内，以非线性 L^p 容量统一描述流形的 L^p 抛物性，并联系正超调和函数的共轭指数 Liouville 性质；给出体积增长判据。
analysis.breakthrough: 修订稿新增黎曼情形的 (2,1)-Laplacian 容量等于两倍通常变分容量的证明，回答早期版本的问题。
analysis.limitations: 一般流形的近最优条件与非负 Ricci 或模型流形上的锐条件应区分；这不是所有内容均首次提出的新稿。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 潜在理论与黎曼几何的基础工具，修订进展明确。
